main.description: Record pinning a chat message for prominent display.

pinnedMessage.description: AT-URI of the pinned chat message.

pinnedBy.description: DID of the user who pinned the message.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration time, used when livestream is not set.

livestream.description: AT-URI of the first chapter of the streamer's broadcast. The pin remains active across chapter changes until that broadcast ends. Takes precedence over expiresAt. Without either field, the pin remains until manually unpinned.
